description: Map only the DYT31 alleles confirmed in the cited primary literature onto the AOPEP canonical sequence and AlphaFold model
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
aop=''.join(requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8N6M6.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
api=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q8N6M6',timeout=120).json()
pdbtxt=requests.get(api[0]['pdbUrl'],timeout=180).text
ca={};plddt={};cb={};tips={}
for l in pdbtxt.split('\n'):
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        i=int(l[22:26]); nm=l[12:16].strip(); xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        if nm=='CA': ca[i]=xyz; plddt[i]=float(l[60:66]); cb.setdefault(i,xyz)
        if nm=='CB': cb[i]=xyz
        if (i,nm) in [(479,'NE2'),(483,'NE2'),(502,'OE2')]: tips[i]=xyz
znc=np.mean([tips[k] for k in sorted(tips)],axis=0)

# Only alleles confirmed in the cited abstracts
AL=[('p.Ala234Serfs*5','A',234,'34596301','frameshift'),
    ('p.Arg255*','R',255,'34596301','nonsense'),
    ('p.Trp259*','W',259,'34596301','nonsense'),
    ('p.Val406Cysfs*14','V',406,'34596301','frameshift'),
    ('p.Arg493*','R',493,'34596301','nonsense'),
    ('p.Met582Cysfs*6','M',582,'34596301','frameshift'),
    ('p.Arg401Trp','R',401,'35306330','missense'),
    ('p.Glu637*','E',637,'35306330','nonsense'),
    ('p.Ala212Asp','A',212,'36933031','missense'),
    ('p.Gly216Arg','G',216,'36933031','missense'),
    ('p.Met291Asnfs*68','M',291,'36933031','frameshift')]
rows=[]
for name,aa,pos,pmid,cls in AL:
    obs=aop[pos-1]
    d=float(np.linalg.norm(cb[pos]-znc)) if pos in cb else np.nan
    rows.append(dict(allele=name,pmid=pmid,klass=cls,expected=aa,canonical=obs,numbering_ok=(obs==aa),
                     dist_to_Zn_A=round(d,1),pLDDT=round(plddt[pos],1),
                     zinc_site_lost=(pos<502)))
B=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print("DYT31 alleles confirmed in cited primary literature, mapped to Q8N6M6 (819 aa) and AF-Q8N6M6 v6:")
print(B.to_string(index=False))
print("\nnumbering matches canonical at", int(B['numbering_ok'].sum()), "/", len(B))
print("truncating/frameshift alleles that remove the zinc site (pos < 502):",
      int(((B.klass!='missense')&(B.zinc_site_lost)).sum()), "/", int((B.klass!='missense').sum()))
m=B[B.klass=='missense']
print("missense allele distances to zinc-ligand centroid (A):", list(zip(m.allele,m.dist_to_Zn_A)))
B.to_csv('provenance/dyt31_allele_mapping.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.4))
c={'missense':'#2980b9','nonsense':'#c0392b','frameshift':'#e67e22'}
for k,g in B.groupby('klass'):
    ax.scatter(g.dist_to_Zn_A,g.pLDDT,c=c[k],s=80,label=k)
for r in B.itertuples(): ax.annotate(r.allele,(r.dist_to_Zn_A,r.pLDDT),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax.axvline(10,ls='--',c='grey'); ax.text(10.3,ax.get_ylim()[0]+2,'10 A from zinc',fontsize=8,color='grey')
ax.set_xlabel('CB distance from AOPEP zinc-ligand centroid (A)'); ax.set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT')
ax.set_title('Published DYT31 AOPEP alleles sit far from the zinc site',fontsize=11); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
